Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid Century Modern Wall Mounted Plug-In Sconce, 7.25"H, Gold
Colors: Gold
Materials: Metal
With its tidy size and cleverly shaped shade, this polished-nickel wall sconce will unobtrusively light a gallery wall or dim hallway with equal ease. Use them singly to highlight a special piece of art or in multiples to make light a larger expanse. Clean, modern design Metal construction A convenient, wall mounted plug-in accent light for any room 5.25''W x 5.25''D x 7.25''H Easy to assemble and clean. Indoor use only.
